types.description: ET 200S 8DI DC24V electronic module; partial assembled field interface with compatible TM-E15x24-01 base

document.title: Digital electronic module 8DI DC24V (6ES7131-4BF00-0AA0)
document.pages: 7–11; diagrams visually reviewed on physical pages 8, 9 and 10

modelingNotes: Assembled field-interface abstraction using TM-E15C24-01, TM-E15S24-01 or TM-E15N24-01 as listed in S1 page 8. Base clamps are separate hardware, not included in this electronic-module order.

1M is the common net label in S1 figure 1-1, used here as a functional internal-return alias; it is not a verified physical clamp or backplane pin number. Its required connection can be provided by explicit assembly wiring; it is not an instruction to wire an external clamp.
Alternative 26-A1 bases expose AUX1 terminals A3/A4/A7/A8. They and their continuity belong to the separate base arrangement and are outside this 24-01 abstraction.
Backplane bus individual contact inventory and P1/P2 contact mapping are unresolved. No numbered backplane contacts or external L+ clamp are inferred.
Nominal supply is 24 VDC from the power module. Inputs: high 15–30 V, low −30–5 V; typical 5 mA at 24 V, delay 2–4.5 ms. Ratings are retained as notes rather than scalar limits.
Channels are application-dependent and do not create fixed electrical links to common or one another. No PE or shield clamp is established for the electronic card by S1.

connectionCoverage.notes: Eight field inputs plus functional internal common 1M are represented for the documented 24-01 base arrangement. Individual backplane supply/common/communication contacts are not enumerated. AUX-equipped 26-A1 bases and their clamps/links are outside this abstraction; electronic card and base remain distinct products.
